Timeline::from_epoch_millis¶

Back to Timeline API Reference

Signature¶

static Timeline Timeline::from_epoch_millis(
    const Series& epoch_millis,
    std::string_view tz_name = "UTC")

Construct From Millisecond Ticks¶

from_epoch_millis() maps each signed millisecond count to its exact nanosecond instant by multiplying by 1,000,000. The input shape becomes the Timeline shape; the operation neither flattens nor broadcasts.

const auto millis = pluss::make_series({-1LL, 0LL, 1'999LL});
const auto times = pluss::Timeline::from_epoch_millis(millis);
std::cout << pluss::series::print(times.epoch_nanos()) << '\n';

Output¶

Series(shape=[3], strides=[1], dtype=int64, platform=cpu, numel=3, contiguous=true)
data=[-1000000, 0, 1999000000]

Negative values retain their sign and exact boundary. Timeline::kNaT propagates as the absent-instant sentinel. An input outside the representable nanosecond range throws before multiplication, including a value that would collide with the reserved sentinel.

Timezone metadata changes rendering and field extraction only. It does not reinterpret these absolute epoch counts as local wall-clock values.
